description: This file defines the UriComposer class implementing the IUriComposer interface, responsible for composing URIs based on catalog settings, specifically replacing a placeholder in a URI template with the base URL from configuration.

classes.name: UriComposer
classes.description: A service class used to compose image URIs by replacing placeholders in URI templates with actual catalog base URLs.

methods.name: ComposePicUri
methods.description: Replaces the placeholder URL segment with the actual catalog base URL from configuration.
